responsibility: Implements the core x86 backend target logic for GCC. This is the main target file that owns machine hooks, ABI and register-class policy, frame layout and prologue/epilogue generation, address legitimacy, operand printing, instruction expansion helpers that are not split into companion files, calling convention handling, scheduling/cost hooks, SIMD clone and vectorization target hooks, target-specific lowering decisions, and final targetm hook initialization for i386 and x86-64 code generation.
same_name_distinction: The executable C++ implementation for the generic x86 backend hooks and code-generation policy; unlike i386.h it provides definitions, unlike i386.md it is not the RTL pattern language file, and unlike i386.opt it does not declare command-line options.
